reviews.title: Lies
reviews.text: This app is a fraud: it would give internal readings of my place, apparently. Then I broke down in my truck in the Arizona desert and was stranded in the desert. No AC. It was 117 deg f outside, confirmed. This fraudulent app still showed 80 degs f in my truck while I sweated. That’s when I knew I had to delete this app and tell everyone else. Don’t bother with this farcical app!

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text: I bought this app because it offered indoor temperature as well as outside and for a lifetime of updates the price was right. You get what you pay for… Cheap. When comparing what this app says for the outdoor temperature is 10-15 degrees or more cooler than what the weather apps say. I can’t say how accurate the app says for the indoor temperature is but if the outdoor is that far off then I can assume the indoor would be off as well. It would be nice if you could calibrate it with other weather apps so you have the right temperature. I wouldn’t recommend this app unless they fix it.
